title: Annabelle Joynes Thompson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Annabelle Joynes Thompson." Historical Document Record (2001). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Obituary: Annabelle Thompson departed Tuesday, August 21, 2001 after a short illness. Born in Temperanceville, Virginia on October 28, 1928, the only daughter of the late Chaney and Carrie Joynes. She met and married Samuel Thompson Jr. in 1959. Survived by her husband Samuel Thompson of Millsboro; seven sons (William Harvey, Deroy, Bradley, Wydell, Douglas, Donnell, and David Thompson); two daughters (Mary Cross and Shirley Thompson); brother Dave Joynes of Salisbury, Maryland; 25 grandchildren and 24 great-grandchildren. Predeceased by her son Gerald Lee Thompson and brothers James and Randolph Joynes. Photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
